heading: Sites for conducting research; availability of personnel and facilities
lead: Research authorized by this chapter may be conducted wherever suitable personnel and facilities are available.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 3 of Pub. L. 86–599 was classified to section 663 of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 109–58, § 1009(a)(1)(C).

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 86–599, § 3, formerly § 5, July 7, 1960, 74 Stat. 337; renumbered § 3, Pub. L. 109–58, title X, § 1009(a)(1)(D), Aug. 8, 2005, 119 Stat. 934.)
